thread:
Anya: Heads-up: nightly eval (job 7623) shows a sharp BLEU drop on Arabic (ar) and zh-TW translation pairs after onboarding redwood-4-quant-q4_k_m. +18% failure rate on ar->en, ~-12 BLEU on zh-TW->en. Examples below.

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary: model=redwood-4-quant-q4_k_m, job=7623, cohort=translate-multilang, delta_bleu_ar_en=-17.8, delta_bleu_zh_tw_en=-11.9, anomalous_tokens=punctuation/numerals

Anya: failing example 1 (ar->en):
```
input: "ترجم الجملة: اليوم ٥/٣/٢٠٢٦ الجو جميل."
ref: "Translate the sentence: Today 5/3/2026 the weather is nice."
model_out: "Translate the sentence: Today 5,3,2026 the weather is nice."
```

Anya: failing example 2 (zh-TW->en):
```
input: "請翻譯：今天，臺北有午後雷陣雨。"
ref: "Translate: Today, Taipei has afternoon thunderstorms."
model_out: "Translate: Today, Taipei has afternoon thunderstorms ,"
(note extra ascii comma separated from previous token)
```

Omar: I looked at raw tokens. For Arabic the model is emitting U+002C (comma) instead of Arabic comma U+060C. BLEU tokenization on our eval expects language-aware punctuation so this reduces score.

Li Wei: I ran a quick bisect across commits touching tokenizer/postprocess. Commit abc123 (2026-03-18) changed default 'punct_split' handling and swapped a normalization map. If I run the same model but force the older tokenizer build, the ar punctuation aligns with ref.

Marco: Quantization could amplify low-prob tokens so a small bias change from tokenizer+quant = visible spike. I ran non-quantized redwood-4 (cpu/gpu) on same inputs: no punctuation errors.

Ken: Repro steps I used:
```bash
# local repro
python -m infra.run_infer --model redwood-4-quant-q4_k_m \
  --tokenizer-version=2026-03-18 --postprocess-unicode-normalize=false \
  --input-file examples/ar_dates.txt \
  > out.txt
```
logs show token 44 (',') probability increased after quant kernel switch.

Omar: Also saw bracket direction issues when mixing Arabic + latin tokens. Example: "(تجربة)" becomes "(تجربة)" but internal spacing changes, sometimes LTR punctuation sits inside RTL span. Probably postprocess Unicode bidi not applied.

Li Wei: Here's the minimal diff in tokenizer map I found:
```diff
- map['，'] -> '，'
+ map['，'] -> ','  # accidental ascii map for all punctuation
```
That would break zh and also affect Arabic if normalization collapsed punctuation sets.

Marco: Quick mitigation: language-aware punctuation remap in postprocess. If lang==ar replace ascii comma with '\u060C', if lang==zh-TW replace ',' with '\uFF0C'.

Sarah: Is this a rollback candidate? If quant model is causing production regressions we need a decision. Ops: SLA alerts triggered for a few enterprise customers in APAC.

Anya: Can we do two things: 1) add a unit test in nightly-eval that checks punctuation tokens for ar/zh-TW/regional locales, 2) run quant kernel sweep to see if this is quant-kernel specific or combined with tokenizer change.

Ken: I'm running a sweep now: Q8 vs Q4_K_M vs FP16 baseline. I'll post numbers in ~30m. Also trying toggling `postprocess-unicode-normalize` true/false.

eval-bot: ticket created TKT-4521: "rtl-punct-quant-regression" assigned to Omar, Ken. Priority=P1 for releases with APAC customers.

Omar: Quick patch applied in local postprocess: language-aware punctuation fallback. Rerun eval locally: ar BLEU delta now -3.2 (was -17.8), zh-TW now -2.1 (was -11.9). Preliminary but promising.

Marco: Good catch. We should add a short regression test in the onboarding harness: ensure punctuation codepoints for ar/zh-TW preserved after decode->postprocess.

Li Wei: I'll open a small PR to revert the accidental punctuation map change in tokenizer and add test vectors for dates/numbers in ar/zh-TW.

Sarah: I'll notify product and legal for customers impacted and flag the quantized model rollout hold until we have regression gate. :exclamation:

Anya: Thanks all. Ken/Marco/Omar please post final sweep numbers and PR links here. I'll update nightly-eval config to include punctuation-sensitive metric.

Ken: posting preliminary sweep results: Q4_K_M w/old-tokenizer: ar delta -2.9, zh-tw -3.0; Q4_K_M w/new-tokenizer: ar -17.8, zh-tw -11.9; FP16 baseline w/new-tokenizer: ar -1.1, zh-tw -0.8. Patch + lang-aware postprocess on new-tokenizer: ar -3.0, zh-tw -2.5.

Anya: Patch + tokenizer revert PRs?

Li Wei: PR #1987 (revert punctuation map) and PR #1988 (postprocess lang-aware fallback) opened. CI running.

eval-bot: CI results: PR #1987 passed, PR #1988 passed, nightly-eval will include new test tomorrow.

Sarah: OK, hold release of redwood-4-quant-q4_k_m until next deploy window. Will update stakeholders.

Anya: Closing loop: create follow-up to add bidi-awareness unit tests (TKT-4522) and cross-locale punctuation vectors. Good job team. :thumbsup:
